filings.risk_factors_summary: Nucor identifies exposure to price fluctuations in raw materials and energy, including scrap, steel, metals, alloys, and natural gas. Passing higher input costs through to product prices is more challenging when demand is weaker, which can pressure the ability to maintain gross margins. The filing also identifies foreign-currency exposure through operations in Canada, Europe, and Mexico. Interest-rate exposure is partly managed through fixed- and variable-rate debt; the filing says future rate changes are not expected to significantly impact earnings.
